summary: Finward Bancorp filed an 8-K solely to disclose a routine quarterly cash dividend of $0.12 per share declared on September 4, 2026, payable September 25, 2026 to shareholders of record September 18, 2026. No acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation event is present. The forward-looking statements boilerplate references unrelated merger risks but does not announce any transaction. This is an ordinary dividend declaration and capital-return event in the normal course, not a special situation requiring classification. No further action or analysis is warranted.
